exposure: Trial of labor vs. pre-labor cesarean delivery
outcome: Maternal outcomes: abruption, estimated blood loss, postpartum hemorrhage, transfusion, chorioamnionitis, hysterectomy, ICU admission, death
Neonatal outcomes: birth injury, 5-minute Apgar score <7, NICU admission, RDS, TTN, sepsis, asphyxia, NICU length of stay, death
finding: While there was an increased risk of postpartum hemorrhage and blood transfusion for mothers who underwent a trial of labor compared to pre-labor cesarean, trial of labor in twins remains a safe and reasonable option in appropriately selected cases.
mod_finding: Term twins undergoing a trial of labor had increased maternal hemorrhage and transfusions.
